claims.text: Larger abrasions (eg, >10 mm²): dilate once with a short-acting cycloplegic (1 drop cyclopentolate 1% or homatropine 5%)
claims.quote: For symptomatic relief of larger abrasions (eg, area > 10 mm2), the pupil is dilated once with a short-acting cycloplegic (eg, 1 drop cyclopentolate 1% or homatropine 5%).
